subject.title: fix(ai): normalize non-conforming tool-call ids reaching Anthropic/Google targets (#95623)

question: Should `targetSafeToolCallIds` become a supported public `plugin-sdk/llm` contract, or should this provider-only mode remain internal?
rationale: The behavior fix is technically sound, but `transformMessages` is public Plugin SDK surface and the repository sets a high bar for adding permanent plugin API contracts.

options.title: Keep The Mode Internal
options.body: Retain the shared transform fix through a provider-internal helper or non-exported control while leaving the existing public SDK signature unchanged.

options.title: Approve The Public Overload
options.body: Accept the additive SDK contract, keep the compatibility test, and document when third-party providers may safely opt into source-independent normalization.

recommendation.title: Keep The Mode Internal
recommendation.body: Retain the shared transform fix through a provider-internal helper or non-exported control while leaving the existing public SDK signature unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The agent-runtime internalization history makes this the strongest available owner for the packages/ai and Plugin SDK boundary.
